# Local vendor assets

- Three.js 0.186.1 — https://www.npmjs.com/package/three — `three.module.js` plus its split `three.core.js`; MIT license in `three/LICENSE`.
- Anime.js 4.5.0 — https://www.npmjs.com/package/animejs — MIT license in `animejs/LICENSE.md`.

Both libraries are loaded only after an explicit user action from the 2D render studio. No CDN or runtime third-party request is used. The scene is a conceptual visual, not engineering design or telemetry.
